steps: Complete a $120.00 sale paid fully with Visa card ending 4417 (txn TXN-10001)
Initiate a full refund for TXN-10001 at the register
expectedResult: Refund of $120.00 is issued to Visa ending 4417; no option to select a different tender is offered

steps: Complete a $45.00 sale paid fully in cash (txn TXN-10002)
Initiate a full refund for TXN-10002
expectedResult: Refund of $45.00 is issued in cash; receipt shows tender CASH

steps: Complete a $80.00 sale paid with Mastercard (txn TXN-10003)
Initiate a refund and attempt to change the refund tender to cash
expectedResult: POS blocks the tender change; refund can only go to the original Mastercard

steps: Initiate a refund using a non-existent transaction ID (TXN-99999)
expectedResult: POS rejects the refund with an 'original transaction not found' error; no refund is issued

steps: Use a card sale with purchase date 15 days ago
Initiate a full refund
expectedResult: Refund is allowed and processed to the original card

steps: Use a sale with purchase date on day 0 (same day)
Initiate a refund
expectedResult: Refund is allowed

steps: Use a sale with purchase date exactly 30 days ago
Initiate a refund
expectedResult: Refund is allowed (day 30 is within the window)

steps: Use a sale with purchase date 31 days ago
Initiate a refund
expectedResult: Refund is rejected with a 'refund window expired' message; no refund issued and no SAP message sent

steps: Use a sale with purchase date 90 days ago
Initiate a refund
expectedResult: Refund is rejected; no refund issued

steps: Complete a $120.00 sale paid as: 1) Gift card $50.00, 2) Visa $70.00 (txn TXN-10010)
Initiate a full refund of $120.00
expectedResult: Visa is refunded $70.00 first, then gift card is refunded $50.00 (reverse order of payment)

steps: Complete a $150.00 sale paid as: 1) Cash $30.00, 2) Gift card $50.00, 3) Visa $70.00
Initiate a full refund of $150.00
expectedResult: Refund order is Visa $70.00, then gift card $50.00, then cash $30.00

steps: Use split-tender sale TXN-10010 (Gift card $50.00, Visa $70.00)
Initiate a partial refund of $40.00
expectedResult: Entire $40.00 is refunded to Visa (last tender used); gift card untouched

steps: Use split-tender sale TXN-10010 (Gift card $50.00, Visa $70.00)
Initiate a partial refund of exactly $70.00
expectedResult: Visa is refunded $70.00; gift card is refunded $0.00

steps: Use split-tender sale TXN-10010 (Gift card $50.00, Visa $70.00)
Initiate a partial refund of $70.01
expectedResult: Visa is refunded $70.00 and gift card is refunded $0.01

steps: Complete a sale with 3 items: Item A $20.00, Item B $30.00, Item C $50.00 (total $100.00)
Refund only Item B
expectedResult: $30.00 is refunded; Items A and C remain on the original transaction as not refunded

steps: Use the $100.00 sale from TC-POS017-015
Refund Item A ($20.00)
In a separate transaction, refund Item C ($50.00)
expectedResult: Both refunds succeed; cumulative refunded amount is $70.00 and remaining refundable balance is $30.00

steps: Use a $100.00 sale
Refund $60.00 in one refund
Refund the remaining $40.00 in a second refund
expectedResult: Both refunds succeed; total refunded equals $100.00 exactly; transaction is marked fully refunded

steps: Use a $100.00 sale already refunded $99.99
Attempt a further refund of $0.02
expectedResult: Refund is rejected because cumulative total ($100.01) would exceed the original amount

steps: Use a $100.00 sale with no prior refunds
Attempt a single refund of $100.01
expectedResult: Refund is rejected; error indicates amount exceeds original transaction

steps: Use a sale that has already been fully refunded
Attempt to refund any line item again
expectedResult: Refund is rejected with an 'already refunded' message

steps: Use a valid $100.00 sale
Attempt a refund of $0.00, then a refund of -$10.00
expectedResult: Both attempts are rejected as invalid amounts

steps: Use a sale of $600.00
Initiate a partial refund of $499.99
expectedResult: Refund processes without a manager approval prompt

steps: Use a sale of $600.00
Initiate a partial refund of exactly $500.00
expectedResult: Refund processes without a manager approval prompt ('over $500' excludes $500.00)

steps: Use a sale of $600.00
Initiate a partial refund of $500.01
expectedResult: POS prompts for manager approval before processing

steps: Use a sale of $750.00
Initiate a full refund
Manager enters valid credentials and approves at the register
expectedResult: Refund of $750.00 is processed; approving manager ID is recorded on the refund

steps: Use a sale of $750.00
Initiate a full refund
Enter credentials of a non-manager associate at the approval prompt
expectedResult: Approval is rejected; refund is not processed

steps: Use a sale of $750.00
Initiate a full refund
Manager cancels/declines at the approval prompt
expectedResult: Refund is cancelled; no money is returned and no SAP message is sent

steps: Use a $90.00 sale paid with a card that has since expired
Initiate a full refund
expectedResult: Refund of $90.00 is issued as store credit; receipt shows STORE_CREDIT

steps: Use a $90.00 sale paid with a card whose account is now closed
Initiate a full refund
expectedResult: Refund of $90.00 is issued as store credit

steps: Use a $90.00 sale paid with a card that is still active and valid
Initiate a full refund
expectedResult: Refund goes to the original card, not store credit

steps: Use a split-tender sale: 1) Gift card $50.00, 2) Visa $70.00, where the Visa has since expired
Initiate a full refund of $120.00
expectedResult: $70.00 (Visa portion) is issued as store credit first, then $50.00 is refunded to the gift card

steps: Process a full card refund of $120.00 for TXN-10001 at store 0421
Capture the outbound refund message to SAP
expectedResult: Message contains refundId, originalTxnId=TXN-10001, amount=120.00, tenderType=VISA, storeId=0421, and a valid timestamp; all values match the refund

steps: Process a refund and record the refund completion time
Record the time SAP receives the refund message
expectedResult: SAP receives the message within 5 minutes (<= 300 seconds) of refund completion

steps: Process a partial refund of $30.00 on a $100.00 sale
Capture the SAP message
expectedResult: amount field is 30.00 (refund amount), not the original 100.00

steps: Process a refund issued as store credit due to an expired card
Capture the SAP message
expectedResult: tenderType is STORE_CREDIT and all other mandatory fields are present

steps: Attempt a refund that is rejected (e.g. 31 days old or over original amount)
Monitor outbound SAP messages for 5 minutes
expectedResult: No refund message is sent to SAP for a rejected refund

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail the first send attempt and succeed on the next
Process a refund
expectedResult: POS retries once and the message is delivered; no error log entry; SAP receives exactly one message

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail the initial send and the first 2 retries, then succeed on the 3rd retry
Process a refund
expectedResult: Message is delivered on the 3rd retry; no error log entry is written

steps: Configure SAP stub to fail all send attempts (HTTP 500)
Process a refund
Count send attempts and check the error log
expectedResult: POS makes exactly 3 retries after the initial attempt (no 4th retry), then writes one error log entry containing the refundId and failure reason

steps: Configure SAP stub to not respond (timeout) on every attempt
Process a refund
expectedResult: Timeouts are treated as failures; POS retries 3 times, then writes an error log entry
